hebrewText: וְ/הִשְׁקָ֣/הּ אֶת הַ/מַּ֗יִם וְ/הָיְתָ֣ה אִֽם נִטְמְאָה֮ וַ/תִּמְעֹ֣ל מַ֣עַל בְּ/אִישָׁ/הּ֒ וּ/בָ֨אוּ בָ֜/הּ הַ/מַּ֤יִם הַ/מְאָֽרֲרִים֙ לְ/מָרִ֔ים וְ/צָבְתָ֣ה בִטְנָ֔/הּ וְ/נָפְלָ֖ה יְרֵכָ֑/הּ וְ/הָיְתָ֧ה הָ/אִשָּׁ֛ה לְ/אָלָ֖ה בְּ/קֶ֥רֶב עַמָּֽ/הּ

tokens.bdb: to quaff, i.e. (causatively) to irrigate or furnish apotion to
tokens.kjv: cause to (give, give to, let, make to) drink, drown, moisten, water. See H7937 (שָׁכַר), H8354 (שָׁתָה).

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.kjv: (as such unrepresented in English).

tokens.bdb: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
tokens.kjv: [phrase] piss, wasting, water(-ing, (-course, -flood, -spring)).

tokens.bdb: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
tokens.kjv: beacon, [idiom] altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall, [phrase] follow, happen, [idiom] have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, [idiom] use.

tokens.bdb: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
tokens.kjv: (and, can-, doubtless, if, that) (not), [phrase] but, either, [phrase] except, [phrase] more(-over if, than), neither, nevertheless, nor, oh that, or, [phrase] save (only, -ing), seeing, since, sith, [phrase] surely (no more, none, not), though, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] unless, [phrase] verily, when, whereas, whether, while, [phrase] yet.

tokens.bdb: to be foul, especially in a ceremial or moral sense (contaminated)
tokens.kjv: defile (self), pollute (self), be (make, make self, pronounce) unclean, [idiom] utterly.

tokens.bdb: properly, to cover up; used only figuratively, to act covertly, i.e. treacherously
tokens.kjv: transgress, (commit, do a) trespass(-ing).

tokens.bdb: treachery, i.e. sin
tokens.kjv: falsehood, grievously, sore, transgression, trespass, [idiom] very.

tokens.bdb: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
tokens.kjv: also, another, any (man), a certain, [phrase] champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), [phrase] none, one, people, person, [phrase] steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare H802 (אִשָּׁה).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.enLiteralWord: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.explanation: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.explanationEn: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term

tokens.bdb: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way.

tokens.bdb: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
tokens.kjv: [phrase] piss, wasting, water(-ing, (-course, -flood, -spring)).

tokens.bdb: to execrate
tokens.kjv: [idiom] bitterly curse.

tokens.bdb: bitter (literally or figuratively); also (as noun) bitterness, or (adverbially) bitterly
tokens.kjv: [phrase] angry, bitter(-ly, -ness), chafed, discontented, [idiom] great, heavy.

tokens.bdb: to amass, i.e. grow turgid; specifically, to array an army against
tokens.kjv: fight swell.

tokens.bdb: the belly, especially the womb; also the bosom or body of anything
tokens.kjv: belly, body, [phrase] as they be born, [phrase] within, womb.

tokens.bdb: to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitive or causative, literal or figurative)
tokens.kjv: be accepted, cast (down, self, (lots), out), cease, die, divide (by lot), (let) fail, (cause to, let, make, ready to) fall (away, down, -en, -ing), fell(-ing), fugitive, have (inheritance), inferior, be judged (by mistake for H6419 (פָּלַל)), lay (along), (cause to) lie down, light (down), be ([idiom] hast) lost, lying, overthrow, overwhelm, perish, present(-ed, -ing), (make to) rot, slay, smite out, [idiom] surely, throw down.

tokens.bdb: the thigh (from its fleshy softness); by euphemistically the generative parts; figuratively, a shank, flank, side
tokens.kjv: [idiom] body, loins, shaft, side, thigh.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: the thigh ; by euphemistically the generative parts; figuratively
tokens.enLiteralWord: the thigh ; by euphemistically the generative parts; figuratively
tokens.explanation: the thigh ; by euphemistically the generative parts; figuratively
tokens.explanationEn: the thigh ; by euphemistically the generative parts; figuratively

tokens.bdb: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
tokens.kjv: beacon, [idiom] altogether, be(-come), accomplished, committed, like), break, cause, come (to pass), do, faint, fall, [phrase] follow, happen, [idiom] have, last, pertain, quit (one-) self, require, [idiom] use.

tokens.bdb: a woman
tokens.kjv: (adulter) ess, each, every, female, [idiom] many, [phrase] none, one, [phrase] together, wife, woman. Often unexpressed in English.

tokens.bdb: an imprecation
tokens.kjv: curse, cursing, execration, oath, swearing.

tokens.bdb: properly, the nearest part, i.e. the center, whether literal, figurative or adverbial (especially with preposition)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] among, [idiom] before, bowels, [idiom] unto charge, [phrase] eat (up), [idiom] heart, [idiom] him, [idiom] in, inward ([idiom] -ly, part, -s, thought), midst, [phrase] out of, purtenance, [idiom] therein, [idiom] through, [idiom] within self.

tokens.bdb: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
tokens.kjv: folk, men, nation, people.
